Respondent/s
 ======================================================
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr. Deepak Kumar Sinha, Advocate
 For the Respondent/s : Mr. Rishi Raj Sinha-SC-19
 Mr. Manoj Kumar Sinha, Ac to Sc-19
 ======================================================
 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Rajiv Roy
 Oral Order
2 15-04-2024 Heard Mr. Deepak Kumar Sinha, learned counsel for the petitioner and Mr. Shrinath Pathak representing N.H.A.I. as also the State.

2. That petitioner invokes the writ jurisdiction of this Hon'ble court for pass appropriate writ/writs,
direction/directions, order/orders for the following reliefs:-
I. To command and direct the respondents for payment of compensation amount related Patna High Court CWJC No.12199 of 2017(2) dt.15-04-2024 to land of petitioner acquired by the Respondent No.8 and 9 for the purpose of construction of National High way i.e. NH 30 and 84 as well as solicium amount which was awarded by District Land Acquisitioned officer less amount i.e. 30% instead of 60% against Ram Nath Singh vs The State Of Bihar And Ors on 15 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/78534835/
1 the land acquisition act 2007 because he is voluntarily ready to give that land to the Govt for the purpose given above and compensation amount on the basis of Agricultural land instead of commercial / Residential land /on the basis of present market value.
II. To further command and direct the respondent to increase the award of Petitioner on the basis of commercial/ Residential land and solacium amount i.c. 60% amount instead of order passed by Land Acquisition Officer Patna in L.A.No.60/2012-13 relates to land of Petitioner on 19.06.2013 for the purpose mentioned above i.e. Mouza Phulwari Thana Patna High Court CWJC No.12199 of 2017(2) dt.15-04-2024 No.35, Khata No.452 Khesra No. 3543, Area- 1.881192, Acre though less calculated amount of compensation was paid to the petitioner in the year 2015.
III. To further direct the respondents that less compensation amount which was paid to the petitioner in the year May 2015, be as per the nature of land i.e. residential/commercial and on the basis of "right to fair compensation and Transparency in land Acquisition Re- habitation and Re-settlement Act 2013 and compensation amount may fixed on the basis of present market value as a residential/commercial as rate fixed by the district registration office Patna. IV.
